s.t:
We’re looking for a Snr. Product Marketing Manager who’s equal parts strategist, storyteller, and builder. If you’re energized by the idea of shaping how innovative construction tech solutions go to market and you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, this might be your next opportunity.
In this role, you will collaborate with marketing, product management, and enablement teams to bring new solutions to market and connect with customers in meaningful ways. Product marketing experience in construction tech is preferred.

Partner with product management to shape needs, positioning and messaging that resonates with real-world users
Identify market trends, collect and synthesize competitive intelligence, and stay close to the customer to uncover opportunities
Define buyer personas, buyer needs, and map the journey from awareness to adoption
Translate technical features into clear, compelling value for our buyers and customers

Own the go-to-market marketing strategy and process for new products and major updates
Support the cross-functional launch planning with sales enablement, product management, and marketing
Create value prop messaging, sales tools, launch content, and campaigns that drive adoption and revenue
Track performance and iterate and optimize

Build feedback loops with customers to inform product and messaging decisions
Collaborate with sales and customer success to surface insights from the field
Contribute to thought leadership and industry conversations-especially in construction tech-through blogs, short-form video, webinars, live- presentations, customer conversations.
Ensure our messaging reflects the real-world challenges and wins of our users

Drive measurable revenue growth through product adoption and usage
Shape how we talk about our products, internally and externally
Bring the voice of the customer into everything we do
Make our team (and our users) smarter with every project you touch

Impact from Day One : You’ll own critical go-to-market initiatives and see your work influence revenue and product strategy.
Growth & Mentorship: Direct exposure to senior leadership, structured learning opportunities, and a clear path for advancement.
Culture of Curiosity: Our team value collaboration, experimentation, and bold thinking. We celebrate wins, learn from failures, and share a passion for transforming how the construction industry works.
A Chance to Shape an Industry: Construction tech is evolving fast. You’ll help define how the market understands and embraces innovation.

Bachelor’s Degree
4+ years in product marketing, product management, or marketing in B2B SaaS
Experience in construction technology, such as estimation, data, project management construction software preferred
Experience leading product launches and working closely with Product teams
Strong writing and storytelling skills, you know how to make complex ideas simple
Pragmatic Marketing certification a plus.

We connect buyers and sellers across the world, processing $300M+ in annual transactions and unlocking a $350B industry opportunity. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about the businesses and people we serve.

The diamond trading industry has historically been fragmented, opaque, and inaccessible. Nivoda was founded to change that: to empower businesses of all sizes and locations to participate in a fair, efficient global marketplace. Every line of code, every integration, every automation we build brings us closer to that mission.

We are looking for a Product Marketing Lead to own how Nivoda explains itself: the positioning, the messaging, and the story that makes independent jewellers understand why we are worth switching to. This is the foundation the rest of marketing is built on, from paid campaigns to sales conversations. You will define who we are for, what we say, and why it lands, and then arm the whole go-to-market team to say it consistently.
This is a hands-on role. You will own positioning and messaging, lead the go-to-market for new product launches, sharpen our competitive edge, and build the sales enablement that turns interest into customers.
You will start as a senior individual contributor with real ownership of product marketing end to end. As the company grows there is room to build a function beneath you, but this is a role for a builder who wants to do the work, not just direct it.
What would YOU be doing?
Own Nivoda’s positioning and messaging: define who we are for, the problems we solve, and the words we use, and keep them sharp as the business evolves.
Lead the go-to-market for product launches. Shape the narrative, coordinate across teams, and make sure new features land with the jewellers they are built for.
Build the competitive intelligence that keeps us ahead: understand the alternatives jewellers weigh, and give the team the arguments that win.
Arm our sales team with the enablement they need, from one-pagers and decks to talk tracks, so every conversation tells a consistent and compelling story.
Own the messaging and narrative on our core product and positioning pages, partnering with the teams who own the website and the signup experience.
Shape our pricing and packaging story so the value is obvious and easy to say yes to.
Feed clear, tested messaging into demand gen and content, so campaigns ladder up to one coherent point of view without ever feeling like an ad.
Ground everything in customer truth: talk to jewellers, run win/loss, and turn what you learn into sharper positioning.
Partner closely with product and the growth PM so what we build and how we talk about it stay in lockstep.
What do we need from YOU?
5+ years in product marketing, ideally at a B2B or marketplace company, with a track record of positioning and launches that moved the business.
You are a builder. You would rather write the messaging, run the launch, and ship the deck than hand it off.
Exceptional writing and storytelling. You can take something complex and make it simple, sharp, and persuasive.
A strategic head for positioning: you can define a market, a segment, and a wedge, and defend your choices.
Comfort with data and customer research. You start from evidence, not opinion.
You work well across functions, especially with sales and product, and you build trust quickly.
Comfort as a senior IC on a small team, building process where none exists, with the ambition to grow a function over time.
You are AI forward, always testing new tools, and learnings new applications of AI to improve your efficiency and effectiveness

Experience marketing to small business owners, retailers, or a trade audience.
A marketplace, self-serve, or product-led growth background.
Sales enablement experience for an SDR or inside-sales motion.
Experience running competitive intelligence or win/loss programs.
A real interest in jewellery, retail, or craft, or the curiosity to fall for the space quickly.

About Supercell
Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars . Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.
So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings , and killing lots of projects.
Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Relocation? Yes!

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Wishing you all the best,

Help make the world more hospitable
The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.
You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.
If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:
Mews runs paid search across multiple markets, and this role owns all of it. As Senior Paid Search Manager, you will set the end-to-end paid search strategy — from campaign planning and execution through to optimisation, testing, and performance reporting — with direct impact on acquisition, revenue, and efficiency targets.
This is a role for someone who has built and run paid search programs at scale. The paid search channel is a core acquisition driver at Mews, and the person in this role will set the strategic direction, define what good looks like across markets, and bring the rigour to back every move with data.
Mews operates in a genuinely complex paid search environment — multiple markets, multiple languages, and a commercial motion that spans SMB through enterprise. The work here is more varied than most paid search roles because of that complexity, and because you will be working directly with Data, Measurement, Finance, Brand, and Regional Marketing teams to tie search activity to real commercial priorities rather than managing a channel in isolation.
What you would do
Own paid search strategy end-to-end across all Mews markets — campaign planning, execution, optimisation, testing, and reporting.
Monitor and optimise performance against acquisition, revenue, ROI, and efficiency targets.
Partner with Product Marketing, Brand, Data, Finance, and Regional Marketing teams to align search activity with commercial priorities.
Identify growth opportunities through experimentation, automation, and new platform capabilities.
Manage agency and platform relationships where applicable and ensure best practice implementation.
Produce insights and recommendations that influence broader performance marketing strategy.
What you would bring
Deep expertise in Google Ads and Microsoft Ads — bidding strategies, attribution, conversion tracking, and web measurement are things you know well, not things you are still learning.
Strong quantitative skills: you are comfortable working with large datasets and interpreting them to make sound commercial judgements.
A clear track record of improving paid search performance against measurable targets — acquisition volume, CAC, ROI, or similar.
Experience with reporting and visualisation tools such as GA4, Looker, Tableau, or SQL.
A solid grasp of digital marketing measurement and experimentation methodologies.
You use AI as a real part of your workflow, not as a novelty.

Experience with automation, scripts, or AI-enabled optimisation techniques in a paid search context.

High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.

Bei uns sitzt Marketing nicht am Ende der Kette. Du bist von Anfang an dabei: wenn Produkte entstehen, wenn Kunden gewonnen werden und wenn Argumente gebaut werden, die standhalten.
Aufgaben
Positionierung und Messaging. Du machst klar, warum Product Mining eine eigene Kategorie ist, warum Soley und warum jetzt. Du entwickelst differenzierte Botschaften je Entscheiderrolle und grenzt uns belastbar ab: gegen BI, gegen Beratungsprojekte, gegen generische AI und gegen den kundenseitigen Eigenbau mit SAP und Power BI.
Business Case. Du baust ein Value-Modell mit dokumentierten Annahmen, das ein Account Executive im Kundengespräch selbst rechnen kann und das einem kritischen Einkauf oder CFO standhält.
Sales Enablement. Du entwickelst die Materialien, die im echten Enterprise-Gespräch funktionieren: Solution Briefs, One-Pager, Executive Presentations, Battlecards, Einwandbehandlung, Success Stories. Du schreibst sie selbst.
Launches. Du führst neue Solutions von der Positionierung über die interne Readiness bis zur Markteinführung. Du entscheidest, was eine echte Markteinführung verdient und was eine Release Note ist.
Stimme des Kunden. Du führst Kundeninterviews und Win/Loss-Gespräche selbst, statt sie dir berichten zu lassen, und leitest daraus ab, was sich an unserer Story ändern muss.
Freigabe der Botschaft. Alle kundenwirksamen Aussagen laufen über dich, auch Anzeigen- und Landingpage-Texte, die von der Kampagnenseite kommen. Du hältst die Kategorie konsistent, ohne zur Bremse zu werden.
Wirkung messen. Du definierst je Maßnahme eine Wirkungshypothese und die passende Kennzahl. Bei uns regiert das Daten-Dashboard, nicht das Bauchgefühl. Reichweite und Klicks sind für uns keine Erfolgsmaßstäbe.
Was die Rolle nicht ist

s.h: Damit du weißt, worauf du dich einlässt
s.t:
Du betreibst keine Kanäle. Paid Media, Kampagnenbudget, Landingpage-Bau, E-Mail-Strecken, Messeorganisation und die Funnel-Logik in HubSpot liegen auf der Demand-Generation-Seite. Du lieferst die Botschaft dafür und gibst sie frei.
Du bist keine interne PowerPoint-Agentur und arbeitest nicht auf Zuruf.
Du bist nicht für Corporate Brand, PR oder Employer Branding zuständig.
Es gibt keine fertige Product-Marketing-Maschine, die du nur betreiben musst. Du baust sie.
Zwei Kennzahlen teilst du dir ausdrücklich mit der Kampagnenseite: die Konversion von qualifizierten Leads in qualifizierte Opportunities und die Konversion unserer zentralen Website-Seiten. Beide bewegt keiner allein.

Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
That is the whole job.
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too.

Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

What the job looks like
Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.
You are a fit if
You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
You are fluent in the whole stack , not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.
You are not a fit if
"That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
You want to be told what to do this week.
You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Why this role is exciting
This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.
You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.
You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

*Notre culture se construit à travers les moments du quotidien, notre comportement, nos prises de décision et notre soutien mutuel.*
*Avec **la Confiance** comme fondation, **la Curiosité** comme boussole, **l-Excellence** comme norme, nous créons un **Impact** durable pour les personnes qui nous entourent et pour notre planète. Nous créons des expériences sensorielles uniques, pour partager des moments précieux avec simplicité.*
*Avec des points de vente dans plus de 90 pays, votre carrière peut vous mener partout. Fiers d-être certifiés B Corp, nous faisons partie d-un mouvement mondial œuvrant pour une économie plus inclusive, équitable et régénératrice.*
*L'Occitane en Provence fait partie du Groupe L'OCCITANE, un fabricant et distributeur international de premier plan, multi-marques, de produits de beauté et de bien-être haut de gamme.*
*Nous offrons des opportunités diverses pour grandir et faire la différence à l-échelle mondiale.*

Soutenir la définition et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie globale Soin du Corps pour élever la désirabilité de la Maison L-Occitane en Provence, renforcer la connexion émotionnelle avec les clients et contribuer à la croissance commerciale sur les marchés. Le rôle assure l-exécution fluide des initiatives globales, en pilotant le développement produit et les campagnes 360°.
Vous serez basé à Plan-les-Ouates et reporterez au Responsable Catégorie Soin du Corps - Marketing Global & Communication 360°.

**1) Stratégie catégorie soin du corps et gestion du portefeuille,** en partenariat avec le Responsable Global Soin du Corps :

**2) Positionnement produit et développement**

* Intégrer les retours des marchés et les insights consommateurs dans le développement.

* Diriger les processus de développement produit de bout en bout, du brief au lancement, en assurant une exécution dans les délais et conforme aux standards d-excellence de la marque.

**3) Stratégie & développement de campagne**

* Assurer l-alignement avec les priorités produit et les objectifs globaux de la marque.
* Diriger la stratégie de campagne et le plan de communication.
* Diriger la création des outils avec le studio créatif et garantir la cohérence globale du contenu sur tous les canaux (retail, digital, RP, médias et social).

* Utiliser les insights pour affiner les concepts produits, la feuille de route, les offres futures et la stratégie de campagne & plan de communication.
* Surveiller la performance et les activités des concurrents.
* Intégrer les retours des marchés et les enseignements post-lancement pour améliorer continuellement la performance de la catégorie.

**Origami Rénovation - Canton de Vaud**
Origami Rénovation accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets de rénovation, de la conception à la réalisation des travaux.
Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons une personne créative, autonome et orientée résultats pour prendre en charge notre **marketing digital et la création de contenu**.
Il s-agit d-un poste très opérationnel : nous recherchons quelqu-un capable à la fois de **développer notre visibilité et notre acquisition en ligne** et de se rendre sur nos projets pour **créer des contenus photo et vidéo de qualité**.
## Vos missions ##
### Acquisition digitale & Meta Ads ###
* Concevoir, lancer et optimiser nos campagnes **Meta Ads - Instagram & Facebook**
* Créer les audiences, campagnes et contenus publicitaires
* Suivre les performances : leads, coût par lead, taux de conversion, ROAS
* Tester régulièrement de nouveaux formats, messages et audiences
* Participer à l'amélioration des landing pages et du parcours de conversion
### SEO & site internet ###
* Développer le **référencement naturel du site Origami Rénovation**
* Identifier les opportunités de mots-clés et de contenus
* Optimiser les pages existantes : structure, contenus, titres, métadonnées et maillage interne
* Rédiger et publier de nouveaux contenus optimisés SEO
* Suivre l'évolution du trafic organique et des positions
* Participer à l'amélioration continue du site et de ses performances
### Réseaux sociaux ###
* Définir et gérer le calendrier éditorial
* Développer notre présence principalement sur **Instagram, Facebook et LinkedIn**
* Imaginer des contenus adaptés à notre univers : architecture, rénovation, design et coulisses des chantiers
* Publier et décliner les contenus selon les différents formats : Reels, Stories, carrousels, posts, avant/après, etc.
* Développer la visibilité et l'engagement organiques de la marque
### Photo & vidéo ###
* Se déplacer régulièrement sur nos chantiers et projets
* Filmer les différentes étapes d'une rénovation
* Réaliser des interviews, témoignages clients et prises de parole
* Photographier les projets, matériaux, détails et réalisations
* Monter les vidéos et créer des formats courts adaptés aux réseaux sociaux
* Produire une banque d'images et de vidéos cohérente avec l'identité premium d'Origami Rénovation
## Le profil que nous recherchons ##
Vous êtes avant tout un profil **polyvalent et très opérationnel**.
Vous savez aussi bien analyser les performances d'une campagne Meta que prendre une caméra pour produire un beau contenu sur un chantier.
**Compétences indispensables :**
* Expérience concrète en **Meta Ads**
* Bonne maîtrise du **SEO**
* Très bonne compréhension d'Instagram et des réseaux sociaux
* Maîtrise de la prise de vue **photo et vidéo**
* Maîtrise du montage vidéo et des formats courts
* Sens esthétique développé
* Excellente maîtrise du français
* Autonomie, organisation et capacité à prendre des initiatives
La connaissance de **WordPress**, des outils d'analyse web et de l'univers de l'architecture, de l'immobilier ou du design constitue un vrai plus.
## Ce que nous recherchons surtout ##
Nous ne cherchons pas uniquement quelqu'un qui « poste sur les réseaux sociaux ».
Nous cherchons une personne capable de comprendre notre activité, d'en extraire les bonnes histoires et de transformer nos projets en **contenus qui renforcent la marque, développent notre visibilité et génèrent de nouvelles opportunités commerciales**.
## Conditions ##
**Taux d'activité : 50 %**
**Lieu : Canton de Vaud**, avec présence régulière dans nos bureaux et déplacements sur nos différents chantiers.
Entrée en fonction : à convenir.
